proposal_accepted: Change the possible-short-stop location allowance from one cell diagonal per sample (two per pair) to one cell diagonal per pair; record the direction of record-level changes and the exposure of quarantined versus retained voyages in the review README. Do not run the endpoint-bracket sensitivity in this round.
reason: Cleaned GFW coordinates lie on the 0.01-degree grid. When both samples of a pair are binned by the same rule, the binned displacement differs from the true displacement by less than one cell in each axis, so by at most one cell diagonal. Subtracting one diagonal per sample doubled that allowance.
rule_before: max(0, d - allowance_i - allowance_j) / (dt + 1 h) < 0.2 kn
rule_after: max(0, d - max(allowance_i, allowance_j)) / (dt + 1 h) < 0.2 kn
review_probe: Four shards (0005, 0009, 0020, 0041) reproduced stored visit flags and guard decisions exactly; with one diagonal, flagged visits fell from 9,107 to 6,277 and quarantined speed-eligible voyages from 9,469 to 7,711. R35 and R70 short-stop visits remain flagged.
